mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_config (config_group, config_key, config_value, config_type, description, is_active, updated_by) VALUES (#{configGroup}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{configType}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ai_config WHERE config_group = #{configGroup} AND config_key = #{configKey}
SELECT * FROM t_ai_config WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY config_group, id
SELECT * FROM t_ai_config WHERE is_active = 1 AND config_group = #{configGroup} ORDER BY id
